newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares off as SKB suffers profittaking.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares off as SKB suffers profittaking.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 1.86 percent on Tuesday, pulled down by profittaking in bank SKB after recent strength on reports the bank will seek a listing abroad, traders said.
"Brokers who bought the share recently at much lower price are now trying to take profits. I do not think this fall is connected to the result of the general election," one trader said.
* The SBI index fell 22.64 points to 1,196.2.
* SKB banka fell 2.22 percent or 1,000 tolars to 44,000 tolars on volume of 9,071 shares.
* Turnover rose to 533.9 million tolars from 205.4 million. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
